page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.n1.3xlarge is a dedicated compute-oriented virtual instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at 2.5 GHz. Built on the KVM hypervisor and x86_64 architecture, this instance features 16 virtual CPUs derived from 8 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled. The system incorporates 32.0 GB of memory, providing 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU core. This hardware profile features hardware acceleration flags including AVX, AVX-512, and AES instructions, alongside 33 MB of L3 cache, but includes no local storage or onboard GPUs.

Benchmark testing highlights a trade-off between single-thread efficiency and multi-core output. Single-core evaluation via stress-ng and Geekbench places single-thread compute performance in the lower percentiles, as demonstrated by a single-core Geekbench score of 936.0. However, multi-core scaling reaches average relative performance levels, yielding a stress-ng multi-core result of 15839.14 and a PassMark CPU score of 16949.88. Memory benchmarks reveal strong cached read bandwidth at 1253.98 GB/sec, though overall PassMark memory performance remains in the lower quartile.

From a resource density and cost efficiency perspective, the instance provides 16 dedicated vCPUs with a 1:2 RAM-to-vCPU ratio suitable for multi-threaded parallel execution without paying for excess memory capacity. Network static web serving throughput measures 10.26 GB/sec and Redis SET performance delivers 21.48 million operations per second. Lacking bundled local storage, persistent disk attaches via block storage. This instance is best suited for parallel compute tasks, software compilation, medium-scale database operations, static web serving, and background multi-threaded ETL jobs.
